notes.title: Hotfixes and cold lunches!
notes.content: Todays patch addresses several of the issues folks have been having with trophies and achievements not being activated or synched to the steam servers. In addition music overlap should now be a thing of the past, and the weird screen offsetting issue when launching a nuke blast has been nuked!

notes.title: Steam keys for bundles
notes.content: We will be giving keys to people who purchased Combat Cats in previous bundles. This will take a few days since we are waiting to hear back from the bundle hosts.
